localStorage.backupLimit: System backups may include app files. Device-only Keychain accessibility is distinct from backing up ordinary app files.
localStorage.deletion: Delete plan removes local plan/evidence/receipts only; already-created native events and scheduled notifications remain. Disconnect removes key and resets connection, leaving saved plans/native items intact. Provider and shared copies have separate controls.

permissionsAndAutomation.remindersUI: Default app notifications, no Apple Reminders list picker
permissionsAndAutomation.executorOnlyCapabilities: Executor supports a supplied calendar identifier with already-full event access and supplied Apple Reminders list with full Reminders access. The current interface exposes neither destination selector; do not market those as available integrations.

providerRetention.summary: store:false does not establish zero retention. API training is opt-in. Standard abuse-monitoring content retention can be up to 30 days with legal/service-protection exceptions; account controls and feature rules apply.

assessmentLimits: The four category choices are proposed source-backed answers, not a completed live provider privacy audit or published Apple label.
Optional AI use is still disclosed conservatively because provider retention may extend beyond servicing the request.
No app account or advertising identifier is created. User ID refers to the provider-account credential; local action UUIDs and native receipts are not asserted to be collected device identifiers.

Freeform task text can contain personal information. No dedicated contact, location, health or financial-record ingestion is implemented; do not treat the absence of dedicated fields as proof users cannot type such information. Reassess data categories if intended or actual collection requires it.
Opening external sites and user-initiated sharing are distinguished from app-owned collection or an integrated merchant/order service.
Native manifest, test success and on-device availability do not prove live OpenAI model compatibility, search access, provider retention or category approval.
